mapper.select: SELECT et.transaction_id AS id, et.transaction_date AS transaction_date, et.transaction_name AS name, et.category_id AS category_id, ec.category_name AS category_name, et.payment_method_id AS payment_method_id, pm.payment_method_name AS payment_method_name, et.amount AS amount, et.shop_name AS shop_name, et.memo AS memo FROM expense_transactions et LEFT JOIN expense_categories ec ON et.category_id = ec.category_id LEFT JOIN payment_methods pm ON et.payment_method_id = pm.payment_method_id WHERE et.user_id = #{userId} AND et.expense_type = 'FIXED' AND et.transaction_date >= #{startDate} AND et.transaction_date < #{endDate} ORDER BY et.transaction_date DESC

INSERT INTO fixed_expense_templates ( user_id, category_id, payment_method_id, fixed_expense_name, amount, payment_day, start_year_month, end_year_month, auto_generate, memo, is_active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{request.categoryId}, #{request.paymentMethodId}, #{request.fixedExpenseName}, #{request.amount}, #{request.paymentDay}, #{request.startYearMonth}, NULLIF(#{request.endYearMonth}, ''), #{request.autoGenerate}, #{request.memo}, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING fixed_expense_template_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense_transactions ( user_id, transaction_date, expense_type, category_id, payment_method_id, fixed_expense_template_id, amount, transaction_name, shop_name, memo, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT fet.user_id, #{transactionDate}, 'FIXED', fet.category_id, fet.payment_method_id, fet.fixed_expense_template_id, fet.amount, fet.fixed_expense_name, NULL, fet.memo, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM fixed_expense_templates fet WHERE fet.fixed_expense_template_id = #{fixedExpenseTemplateId} AND fet.user_id = #{userId} AND fet.is_active = TRUE AND fet.auto_generate = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM expense_transactions et WHERE et.user_id = fet.user_id AND et.fixed_expense_template_id = fet.fixed_expense_template_id AND et.transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(#{transactionDate} AS DATE)) AND et.transaction_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(#{transactionDate} AS DATE)) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
